text:
Rory Hale: Proposal: "Build-Your-Own Taco Lab" next Wed 6:30pm in the lounge. taco bar + salsa showdown (mild/medium/volcano). BYO toppings encouraged. :taco:
Jun Park: omg yes. can we also have a non-dairy crema option? im allergic to dairy.
Esme Li: Ill bring a cilantro-lime slaw and a big bowl of chipotle black beans (vegan).
Carlos Ortiz: count me in. happy to man the grill for the meats. will do chicken + carnitas.
Priya Nair: i can bring three salsas for the showdown (mild mango, verde, habanero-lime). poll for heat level please: 1) keep it mellow 2) some spice 3) full-on volcano
Rory Hale: quick poll results so far: 1) mellow (Jun) 2) some spice (Esme) 3) volcano (Carlos) 
SnackBot: Event created: "Taco Lab & Salsa Showdown" Wed 6:30PM  #lunch-plans invited.
Rory Hale: RSVP link: https://tinyurl.com/rw-taco-lab (just name + food prefs)
Jun Park: RSVP done (dairy allergy).
Esme Li: RSVP done (vegan).
Carlos Ortiz: RSVP done (gluten-free tortillas ok?).
Rory Hale: yes gf tortillas on deck. budget: $12 suggested to cover proteins + chips + drinks. Venmo pool link posted when we have final headcount.
Priya Nair: prep checklist for volunteers (copyable):
```
- heat up tortillas at 6:15
- set up toppings station (labels for allergens)
- keep a spare cooler for beers
- tasting ballots for salsa showdown
- trash bags + napkins
```
Esme Li: ill do tasting ballots and keep them anonymous. fun prize for the winning salsa? small weird trophy? :trophy: 
Carlos Ortiz: i can craft a tiny cardboard sombrero. prize accepted. :smile:
Jun Park: logistical ask: can someone bring a tablecloth? sticky fingers incoming.
Rory Hale: @Priya can you grab a couple? also need two volunteers for teardown at 8:45.
Priya Nair: grabbing tablecloths. i can stay for teardown.
Carlos Ortiz: i can help tear down.
Rory Hale: perfect. final note  if youre bringing extras (hot sauce, extra tortillas), please mark them so people don't double up. i'll post final headcount Tue afternoon and Venmo link Wed morning. thanks yall! :confetti_ball:
SnackBot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before event -> "Taco Lab final headcount" in #lunch-plans.
Rory Hale: also open to mini karaoke after if ppl want to keep the fiesta going. no pressure. :microphone:
